matched_identifier.generation: independent CSPRNG UUIDv4 public alias, stable and owner-scoped

preview.generation: server CSPRNG UUIDv4, never derived from file or content
preview.owner_scope: authenticated principal only; no owner claim in the body
preview.immutability: group version, mapping, rows, decisions, counts and expiry are immutable; editing any of them makes a new reference
preview.expiry: server-stated absolute expires_at after created_at; no unstated client TTL
preview.commit_requires: no review rows and a complete effective mapping
preview.unavailable: missing, unknown, foreign or expired uncommitted references receive identical import_preview_unavailable; no reference or account state is echoed
preview.replay: same preview reference returns its first immutable commit result/body/status, including under a different request key, with no new fact or link; Import-Commit-Replayed header is true
preview.atomicity: preview consumption and its stored receipt commit in the same transaction as all financial effects; concurrent commit serialises on principal/preview
preview.receipt_retention: at least P30D from first commit; check for a committed receipt before rejecting uncommitted-preview expiry
preview.idempotency: both preview and commit require the accepted IdempotencyKey parameter; same key/different preview payload is idempotency_payload_mismatch; request replay mints no candidate or link

confidence.derivation: ADR-016 applies suggestions above the owning policy threshold and sends lower or unestablished confidence to clarification; these two wire names are chosen by this provider, not claimed to pre-exist
confidence.high: meets the owning categorisation/source-pair acceptance policy; not consent, not authoritative category assignment and never permission to overwrite USER/RULE/IMPORT precedence
confidence.low: below threshold or confidence cannot be established; requires clarification before commit
confidence.numeric_threshold_owner: categorisation/inference and source-pair implementation policies; no invented universal model score or middle threshold

window_rule: New T-CON-10 source policy: inclusive maximum absolute occurred_at difference, symmetric per source pair, minutes for SMS/notification and days for import/AA. The server selects candidates and decides matches; clients only show the named window. An operation screen uses its owning contract's structured fields/window, default same_local_day, and never fabricates an ingestion source/confidence.
dedup_rule: The matched surviving record and every link/provenance ID are public and same-owner. Exact structured collision is only a candidate. Source precedence never overwrites a user-confirmed value. Both records remain; suppression is visible as suppressed_by_link with can_unmerge=true; posted duplicates use reversing facts, not ledger UPDATE/DELETE. Reversal has restored status, an absolute reversed_at and can_unmerge=false.
duplicate_screen_rule: No effect, no created record and no queue acknowledgement. Different fact retains the same persisted key/bytes and uses DuplicateOverride equal to the current same-owner matched ID. Unknown/foreign overrides receive identical 400 validation_rejected. Changed/additional matches return the current outcome again; no match executes as new with no override. Endpoint adoption and operation-specific screen fields/windows remain contracts#1/consumer work.
mapping_rule: Only ordinal positions and typed semantic roles cross the component. Detected/override bindings are unique and ascending by column; overrides replace that column; effective targets are unique; unmapped_columns is the exact sorted complement. Complete mapping has amount/currency and occurred_at or value_date. Category labels are resolved under ADR-016 and create no category without explicit confirmation.
commit_decision_rule: Commit revalidates create rows; a create may be created, visibly linked/skipped, or rejected. A previewed skip/reject never becomes a new fact. A changed matched surviving-record identifier invalidates the reviewed duplicate decision and needs a new preview/decision, not silent substitution. Row errors name the same source row and an existing mapped column position.
row_reason_rule: ready/duplicate/not_selected/invalid/needs_review are content dispositions, not error codes. Actual row rejection uses ImportRowError.problem and the same T-CON-12 code, field, reason and fixed safe message. Preview row errors repeat the row's position; duplicate suppression in commit includes the visible reversible outcome.

count_metrics.rule: Derive the response counts and metrics from the same row result collection once; total is collection length and sum of action counts. A replay increments no imported-row metric. Logs contain group version, public correlation and counts/codes, not row contents, IDs, mapping values or monetary values.

privacy.rule: Every object is closed; nested maps and arbitrary strings are not escape hatches. No raw row/file/account values, provider text or raw-derived/server fingerprints cross this group.
